name: Polly Pocket: Flower Surprises
summary:
Do you enjoy looking at pretty flowers? If so, why not grow your own in the Polly Pocket: Flower Surprises game? The cute teenager loves to pick up new hobbies, and this time she wants to be a gardener. Will you join Polly and learn all about plants together?

Do you know what the first step to growing your own flowers is? That is, of course, planting the seeds! Your bubbly friend has prepared a wide array of options for you to try. Make your choice, and see what plant you will uncover!
